scripts.build: npm run build:pcb && npm run build:top-plate && npm run build:bottom-plate
scripts.test: npm run test:erc && npm run test:drc
scripts.build:pcb: kicad-cli pcb export gerbers --output pcb/gerber/ --layers F.Cu,B.Cu,F.Mask,B.Mask,F.Paste,B.Paste,F.Silkscreen,B.Silkscreen,Edge.Cuts --no-x2 --subtract-soldermask pcb/tairakb.kicad_pcb && kicad-cli pcb export drill --output pcb/gerber/ --drill-origin absolute --excellon-units mm --excellon-zeros-format decimal pcb/tairakb.kicad_pcb && kicad-cli sch export pdf --output pcb/tairakb.pdf pcb/tairakb.kicad_sch && kicad-cli pcb export pdf --output pcb/tairakb-assembly-front.pdf --mode-single --layers F.Silkscreen,F.Fab,Edge.Cuts --include-border-title pcb/tairakb.kicad_pcb && kicad-cli pcb export pdf --output pcb/tairakb-assembly-back.pdf --mode-single --mirror --layers B.Silkscreen,B.Fab,Edge.Cuts --include-border-title pcb/tairakb.kicad_pcb
scripts.build:top-plate: kicad-cli pcb export gerbers --output plates/top/gerber/ --layers F.Cu,B.Cu,F.Mask,B.Mask,F.Paste,B.Paste,F.Silkscreen,B.Silkscreen,Edge.Cuts --no-x2 --subtract-soldermask plates/top/taira-top-plate.kicad_pcb && kicad-cli sch export pdf --output plates/top/taira-top-plate.pdf plates/top/taira-top-plate.kicad_sch && kicad-cli pcb export pdf --output plates/top/taira-top-plate-assembly-front.pdf --mode-single --layers F.Silkscreen,F.Fab,Edge.Cuts --include-border-title plates/top/taira-top-plate.kicad_pcb && kicad-cli pcb export pdf --output plates/top/taira-top-plate-assembly-back.pdf --mode-single --mirror --layers B.Silkscreen,B.Fab,Edge.Cuts --include-border-title plates/top/taira-top-plate.kicad_pcb
scripts.build:bottom-plate: kicad-cli pcb export gerbers --output plates/bottom/gerber/ --layers F.Cu,B.Cu,F.Mask,B.Mask,F.Paste,B.Paste,F.Silkscreen,B.Silkscreen,Edge.Cuts --no-x2 --subtract-soldermask plates/bottom/taira-bottom-plate.kicad_pcb && kicad-cli sch export pdf --output plates/bottom/taira-bottom-plate.pdf plates/bottom/taira-bottom-plate.kicad_sch && kicad-cli pcb export pdf --output plates/bottom/taira-bottom-plate-assembly-front.pdf --mode-single --layers F.Silkscreen,F.Fab,Edge.Cuts --include-border-title plates/bottom/taira-bottom-plate.kicad_pcb && kicad-cli pcb export pdf --output plates/bottom/taira-bottom-plate-assembly-back.pdf --mode-single --mirror --layers B.Silkscreen,B.Fab,Edge.Cuts --include-border-title plates/bottom/taira-bottom-plate.kicad_pcb

name: taira-keyboard
description: A wireless low-profile split mechanical keyboard with 66 keys inspired by the ErgoDash and Corne Chocolate. It runs ZMK on two nice!nanos, is fully wireless via Bluetooth and uses Kailh Choc V1 switches in a 18x19mm grid layout.
